question: Does a low but positive mobilization band robustly outperform both zero mobilization and capital-exhausting mobilization because recruitment simultaneously increases rooted social survival and consumes financial runway?
primary_gates: Mean joint-viability fraction across interior rates 0.03125/0.0625/0.125 exceeds zero-mobilization viability by at least 0.05.
Mean interior joint viability exceeds 0.25x viability by at least 0.50.
At 0.25x, at least 75% of observed collapses are capital-triggered.
At 0x, stochastic collapse is the plurality cause among any observed collapses and capital-triggered collapse fraction is <=0.25.
secondary: Do not require the exact best rate to repeat at 0.0625x.
Report rooted mass, operational force, capital, cumulative recruitment, and runway ratio by cell.
If the interior band does not beat zero by the preregistered margin, retain the metabolic ceiling but retract the stronger interior-optimum claim.
guard: Fresh synthetic confirmation only; no empirical recruitment-rate recommendation.
